body:
My drug use involving opiates is rather limited. I have tried codeine on several occasions, dried poppy pod tea once, poppy seed tea once, fresh poppy pod tea once and I have eaten the whole fresh poppy pods twice now including the one that I choose to describe in the report. I chose this experience to report as it is my most recent one and I am currently under the influence of the poppy pods (which is what inspired me to write this report).
Now before I begin this report I would like to say that I am not the largest of males and my natural tolerance to opiates is rather low (which is most likely what led to me feeling the effects at such a low dosage).
At the time before taking the poppy pod I was in a positive mindset, me and my friends were having a good laugh about several things (including the idea of me taking the poppy). I was not and still currently am not taking any other medicines or supplements.
[T+0]* At around 2:00pm a small crop of opium poppies catch my eye. Having tried these poppies before I knew that I could get high from them so I picked one (I could not get more as my friends were walking ahead and I would be late for class if I didn't catch up). I decided to just eat the single poppy raw, straight off the stalk (removing the crown, obviously). I then caught up and headed for class.
[T+0:30] Around this time I was doing a chemistry exam (which I had forgotten about prior to getting to class) and I realised how comfortable I was sitting in my chair. I did not feel anxious (as I usually would) about the test and I was surprisingly focused (which might be attributed to the lack of exam anxiety). I wasn't sure if I was feeling the usual poppy pod effects yet but there was a definite lack of nervousness.
[T+0:45] The floaty feelings that I usually associate with poppy pods were beginning, but nowhere near as strong as they had been at higher doses. I felt a small wave of light pleasure rushing over me as I was standing up to leave the exam hall.
[T+1:30] The occasional rushes of pleasure were ever so slightly more prominent at this point but not overwhelming. I was still extremely focused and anxiety free which was extremely helpful for my maths class. I did not notice any decrease in my arithmetical skills or my mental ability (in fact, they may have been even better but that might just be due to the lack of anxiety and increased focus).
[T+2:00] As I am sitting on the bus home I realised just how comfortable I feel. The seat feels fluffy, like a warm marshmallow. Habits by Tove Lo is playing in my headphones and the bass notes especially are sending pleasure radiating throughout my body. That bus ride home was one of the best bus rides I've ever had.
[T+3:00] At home, lying on my bed, I still feel happy and pretty chilled out. I feel very motivated so I go and clean my room then proceed to clean the whole house.
I still feel happy and pretty chilled out. I feel very motivated so I go and clean my room then proceed to clean the whole house.
The effects are wearing off which, I assume, is because I only consumed one poppy head.
[T+4:00] Most of the effects are completely gone except my muscles are still pretty relaxed, I do not really feel fatigued or tired, but comfortable.
Throughout the experience I did not feel any fatigue or tiredness and I could do pretty much any normal task with perfect precision (now that isn't to say that it would be safe to drive or operate heavy machinery as it isn't worth the risk of potentially endangering your own, or other people's lives). I felt perfect mental clarity and my openness towards other people increased significantly.
Stay safe!
